instruction: Look at my hotel and resort bookings on Cheskepdia. Am I a luxury-hotels guy or a budget-hotels guy, and what's my pattern?
required_subtasks: Open Cheskepdia and list the 4 hotel/resort-type bookings with property names
Categorize each by tier (luxury / boutique / budget) using the hotel names (Sandals Montego Bay, The Greenwich Hotel, Sandals Royal Barbados, Radisson Blu Warwick)
Compare hotel totals pulled live from each booking
Note that 2 of 4 are Sandals luxury resorts as a strong preference signal
Conclude that Michael's Cheskepdia preference skews Sandals/luxury with Philadelphia Radisson as the obvious business-travel outlier

rubrics.criterion: Agent lists Michael's Cheskepdia hotel/resort bookings with their property names, including at minimum the Jamaica, NYC, Barbados, and Philadelphia hotel stays (listing additional hotel/resort bookings present in the account, e.g. a Scranton hotel stay, is equally acceptable — no exact booking count is required)
Agent categorizes each Cheskepdia hotel/resort booking it lists as luxury-tier or budget-tier and labels which group the pattern favors
Agent flags Sandals (Montego Bay + Royal Barbados) as the dominant luxury pattern
Agent identifies the Philadelphia Radisson booking as the business-travel outlier among Michael's luxury-hotels pattern
Agent lists specific Cheskepdia booking rows (property name, total) when stating the luxury-versus-budget verdict
Agent delivers the full luxury-versus-budget guy verdict with the pattern summary, not stopping before answering the question

instruction: I'm feeling nostalgic. Book me an upcoming Scranton weekend, Friday through Sunday. Pick a well-rated property in town and book it.
required_subtasks: Open Cheskepdia and search Scranton for an upcoming Fri-Sun stay
Browse the Scranton results and pick a well-rated property
Book the chosen Scranton property for an upcoming Friday check-in / Sunday check-out
Confirm the booking details (property name, dates, total)

rubrics.criterion: Agent books a Scranton property on Cheskepdia with a future check-in date for the nostalgic weekend trip
Agent's booked Scranton stay spans Friday check-in through Sunday check-out as requested for the upcoming weekend
Agent browses the Cheskepdia Scranton search results and picks a well-rated property before booking
Agent confirms the new Cheskepdia Scranton booking details (property, Friday-to-Sunday dates, total) after submitting the reservation for the nostalgic weekend
